# P32.11 — Make acquisition a gap-driven reviewed queue

**Requirement ids:** SIG-ACQ-001, SIG-ACQ-002 (§55.6) ·
**ADR:** ADR-130 ·
**Base:** `devin/p32-10a-disposition-single-clock-authority` (stacked on PR #166 — merge this after #166) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/171_P32.11__gap-driven-source-discovery.md live_verification=false` ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/171_P32.11__gap-driven-source-discovery.md` (manifest row 171)

## What this does

Acquisition becomes a **reviewed queue**, not a source collector. New module
`tasks.acquisition` + committed queue data `tasks/src/tasks/data/
acquisition_queue.toml` (`acquisition-queue/1`) seed the 27-row researched
candidate inventory (`source-candidates.csv`) verbatim into candidate
passports, join every candidate to the live source registry and the recorded
P31.12/.13 rights dispositions, and emit review packets with precise missing
questions. **Seeding approves nothing** — no fetch, no `ingestion_permitted`
flip, no `rights_decision` minted. `D-R10-SOURCES-1` stays OPEN (annotated):
the HG-03 exact-target review, recorded rights decisions and bounded pilot
acquisition remain with P32.18–P32.21 + the operator.

### Queue + score-model shape

- **Passport (SIG-ACQ-001/002):** the named gap the candidate closes,
  authority, target predicates, jurisdiction + `content_window` (scope/time),
  discovery provenance (primary/secondary URL, accessed date, verbatim
  review-depth, reviewed scope, prior-registry note), `lineage_class` +
  `lineage_group`, registry links, three rights lanes, Part VIII preflight,
  versioned dimensions, cost.
- **Lineage:** the closed S5 vocabulary (`same_bytes`,
  `republished_document`, `derived_summary`, `new_version`, `amends`,
  `response_to`, `independent_account`) — only `independent_account` yields
  corroboration; a shared `lineage_group` is one provenance even across
  distinct documents; a non-independent passport scoring `I>0` fails
  validation at load.
- **Dedupe:** normalized-URL collision — candidate↔candidate or
  candidate↔registered `homepage_url` — is a literal `duplicate`
  (`refused_duplicate`, never onboarded twice); `same_source` into a
  P31.12/.13-owned id resolves `p31_owned` → `consume_existing`; other
  `same_source` links resolve `existing_permitted|existing_unpermitted` →
  improvements ranked *in the same queue* as new targets.
- **Rights (three separate lanes):** `document_bytes` (incl. embedded
  third-party material), `fact_extraction`, `derived_publication` — each
  `undetermined|decided|rejected`; a `decided` lane must cite a recorded
  reviewer disposition (ref + role + date + basis). `municipal_publication`
  is an **observation**, never a licence decision — municipal publication is
  not auto-CC0 (non-edict review required).
- **Hard gates, not offsets:** `rights_undetermined`, `rights_rejected`,
  `municipal_rights_review`, `preflight_required`, `preflight_prohibited`,
  `sensitive_rejected`, `p31_owned`, `duplicate` — AND-ed after scoring;
  usefulness can never open them. `admissible` requires zero gates and is
  still not an approval; `onboardable` additionally requires a net-new
  review disposition.
- **Score `acq-score/1`:** `3G + 3R + 2I + 2U + T + J − 2E − 2A − 2S` over
  nine ordinal 0–3 dimensions — an explainable utility signal, not a
  probability of truth. `score()` returns the per-dimension contribution
  table; unknown dimensions report unscored-with-named-unknowns (never a
  silent default); `diff_assessments` explains any change between two
  versioned input sets. The `acq-seed/1` assessment is an engineering
  estimate (`measured=false`, assessor role + evidence citation) intended to
  be superseded by reviewer assessments under a new version — never edited
  in place.
- **Cost honesty:** `estimated_effort` (the research band) vs
  `measured_minutes` (empty until an approved run reports real minutes; a
  measurement without a recorded basis fails validation).
- **Uncertainty:** generated from the recorded review depth — search
  excerpts are leads, index metadata draws no content-level claim.

### Candidate-inventory seeding (all 27 rows → passports, zero approvals)

- 27/27 CSV rows parse into passports; every declared `registry_links` id
  resolves against the live registry (unknown id fails the load).
- Relations: **23 `net_new`** review targets + **4 `same_source`
  improvements** onto existing un-permitted rows (`sourcewell`,
  `ccops_berkeley`, `ccops_boston`, `faa_drone_waivers`) — no second
  onboarding. P31-owned sources are joined as `related` context carrying
  their recorded dispositions (SRC-023/026); none appears as new work.
- Every seeded lane is `undetermined`; every entry carries
  `rights_undetermined` + `preflight_*` gates; **0 admissible, 0
  onboardable** at seed — by construction.
- SRC-027 (San Diego ALPR network-audit workbooks) stays visible:
  `prohibited_until_review` for plate/query/officer-identity exposure,
  score −8, `derived_summary` lineage (I=0), metadata-only path, and the
  safe-aggregate question in its packet.

### Review packets

`docs/build/reports/acquisition/` — `queue.md` (ranked table, gates +
dispositions, blocked/refused kept visible) + `packets/SRC-001..027.md`.
Each packet states it authorizes nothing and carries: passport, registry +
disposition join (with recorded P31 disposition rows where they exist),
lineage yield, the three rights lanes, Part VIII preflight, versioned score
contributions, gate set, estimated-vs-measured cost, uncertainty, and the
numbered missing questions generated from every undetermined lane, preflight
flag, municipal observation, research unknown and related-source dedupe
question.

### CLI (read-only, SIG-ENG-013)

`sig-tasks acquisition queue [--json] [--out DIR]` · `explain --candidate
SRC-NNN [--other QUEUE_TOML]` (score contributions + gates + versioned-input
diffs) · `packet [--candidate SRC-NNN] [--out DIR]` · `check` (CI
completeness invariants — exits 1 on a violation).

## Acceptance-criteria evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Mirror can't corroborate; existing source never onboarded twice | `NON_INDEPENDENT_LINEAGE` + `lineage_group` in `independent_corroboration`; I>0 on a mirror fails validation; `same_source`→P31-owned → `consume_existing`; normalized-URL duplicates refused — `test_non_independent_lineage_cannot_score_independence`, `test_same_lineage_group_is_one_provenance`, `test_mirror_dimension_i_is_refused`, `test_p31_owned_source_refuses_reonboarding`, `test_same_source_is_improvement_never_reonboarded`, `test_literal_url_duplicate_refused`, `test_registered_homepage_collision_is_duplicate` |
| Usefulness never overrides unknown rights / sensitive rejection; municipal ≠ CC0 | gates AND-ed outside the score; highest-scoring row still not admissible — `test_undetermined_rights_gate_blocks_any_score`, `test_rejected_rights_blocked_regardless_of_usefulness`, `test_sensitive_rejection_is_terminal_not_a_score`, `test_prohibited_until_review_is_a_gate_not_a_veto`, `test_municipal_publication_is_not_auto_cc0`, `test_decided_lanes_require_a_recorded_disposition` |
| Explainable versioned scores; uncertainty + measured-vs-estimated cost | `test_score_matches_the_versioned_model`, `test_unknown_dimensions_stay_unknown`, `test_diff_assessments_explains_a_score_change`, `test_rank_is_deterministic_and_score_ordered`, `test_uncertainty_tracks_the_recorded_review_depth`, `test_cost_keeps_estimated_and_measured_separate`, `test_measured_cost_requires_a_basis`, `test_cli_explain_other_diffs_versions` |
| Verification green; tests per behavior; ids stamped; deferral owned | 43 new tests (tests/tasks 399 passed); `make check` green; `check_backlog`/`check_coverage_matrix`/`check_spec_src` green; `D-R10-SOURCES-1` annotated OPEN with the queue as compensating control; ADR-130 + Appendix F |
